SLICE 2 - NO adapters/pdf/maps/433aoi.totals.json IS AUTHORED IN THIS SLICE, DELIBERATELY. run-form-gate.mjs step 10 checks a totals file whenever one EXISTS. Its feeder schema can add and it can subtract (a feeder may carry sign: -1); it cannot MULTIPLY and it cannot carry a printed CONSTANT. Two of this page's computed cells need exactly those: (3a) needs Times_7 = current market value X .8, and (1) needs 'Add lines (1a) through (1c) minus ($1,000)'. A totals file authored now would switch step 10 on while being structurally incapable of checking the two cells on this page that most need checking, and the other eight lines would report a clean pass beside them. That is the 'no declared state' condition this repo keeps finding defects in. So the arithmetic is declared here under _computed, verified by read-back in this slice, and step 10 stays SKIPPED with its reason printed until the feeder schema gains a factor and a constant. Recorded for Principal as a TOOL change, not a map change - the same direction of fix as generalising verify-form-coverage.mjs to accept a top-level _never_autofill.

SLICE 4, COMMIT 1 - THE FEEDER PREDICATE, AND THE CONDITION IT WAS GRANTED ON. A totals feeder may now carry ONE optional `when`, and `when` is ONE equality test against ONE bound key: {"key": "...", "equals": "..."}. No negation, no AND/OR, no nesting, no comparison operators, no expressions - run-form-gate.mjs REFUSES a clause carrying any third field, so a second condition cannot arrive by the back door. The key is spelled the way this map already spells cells in its `exclusive` guard ("6ac_vehicles[0].lease_or_own"), so no new addressing was invented. THREE THINGS MAKE IT SAFE RATHER THAN CONVENIENT: (i) a predicate over an unbound key is a STOP, not a skip; (ii) an `equals` naming an option the set does not have is a STOP, because such a predicate could never be true and would disable its line forever while reading as a clean pass; (iii) a false predicate SKIPS the line and PRINTS the key and the value it actually found, and the step reports checked/skipped/failed as three separate numbers - a form that skips fifteen of twenty totals must read as such at a glance. All four of those failure paths were run deliberately in slice 4 and each one fired.

check_here._why: A construct this form needs and 433-A does not. Every checkbox set on 433-A pairs an affirmative target with a negative one, so `checkboxes` can always name an option for either answer. exclusive._note_page_2: PAGE 2 DECLARES ONE EXCLUSIVE SET AND TWO NON-EXCLUSIVE LISTS, AND THE REASON IS RECORDED ON EACH. (a) 3a_type_of_retirement_account IS exclusive: a single retirement account has ONE tax character. It is a 401(k) or an IRA or something else; it cannot be two, and a row claiming two would be claiming two accounts in one printed row. (b) Bank account type on (1a)/(1b) is NOT exclusive: an account can truthfully be both a Checking account and an Online Account, which are two of the printed options on the same row. (c) Investment type on (2a)/(2b) is NOT exclusive: one brokerage account can hold both stocks and bonds, and the page prints no 'check one' instruction over any of the three lists. Declaring (b) or (c) exclusive would assert a constraint the page does not print and would hard-stop a truthful record. WHAT THAT GIVES UP is covered instead by run-form-gate.mjs step 2, which asserts that no checkbox is already checked on the BLANK source PDF - the one defect a non-exclusive list cannot catch, now guarded form-wide across every box on all seven forms rather than only on the lists that could have been forced exclusive. 2c_digital_asset_held is absent for the same reason s1_community_property_state_last_10_years is: a lone box has nothing to be exclusive with.
exclusive._note: Guard, not a binding. Yes/No pairs and option sets on these forms are INDEPENDENT AcroForm checkboxes - nothing in the PDF stops two of them being checked at once - so the constraint is asserted here and read back off the saved form. Every target below is also bound above; that duplication is the point, and verify-form-coverage.mjs treats this root as a guard so it is not counted as a second binding. s1_community_property_state_last_10_years is deliberately ABSENT: a lone box has nothing to be exclusive with.
exclusive._note_page_3: BOTH PAGE-3 SETS ARE EXCLUSIVE, AND THE REASON IS RECORDED ON EACH. (a) 5_real_property_for_sale is a Yes/No pair on one printed question - a property either is or is not for sale, and a form answering both has answered neither. exclusive._note_page_4: PAGE 4 DECLARES THREE EXCLUSIVE SETS AND ONE NON-EXCLUSIVE LIST, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME ON THIS FORM ONE OF THEM IS DECLARED ON THE PAGE'S OWN WORDS. rounding._the_mixed_scope_finding_measured: MEASURED, not estimated, and RE-DERIVED BY THE GATE each run rather than retyped here. Of the 40 declared totals on pages 1-5, exactly TWO cross a rounding boundary. Box A: total in nearest_whole_dollar while operands (5), (6) and (7) are in none_printed blocks. Box B: total in nearest_whole_dollar, operand (8) under the same rule, operand (11) in the none_printed P5_SECTION_5_CONTINUED — the first crosser with only ONE operand on the far side. Every other total shares its operands’ rule. Worst-case divergence for Box A was brute-forced over all 1,000,000 cent-combinations of its three fractional operands: |round(sum of operands) - sum of rounded operands| reaches 1 and never 2, first at cents (0.00, 0.01, 0.49). Box B has one fractional operand and is bounded by the same 1. So the two PREPARATION METHODS — round the sum, or round each line and add — can differ by at most one dollar on this form. THE ENGINE AND THE PAGE CANNOT: step 11 recomputes each Box from its PRINTED operand cells and rounds by that Box’s own block, so both reconcile exactly and neither needs a tolerance or a not_checkable declaration. Step 11 prints the crossing list every run, so this count cannot silently go stale the way the count in this very sentence did when page 5 landed.
